attchmntText: Rishabh Instruments Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Rishabh Instruments Limited published its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisements were published in English and Marathi newspapers on November 15, 2026. The information is hosted on the company website. Mega Fin India Limited reported a net loss of 4.58 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and a net loss of 4.94 lakhs for the half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board approved these results on November 13, 2026. The company held its Annual General Meetings for financial years ending March 31, 2025, and March 31, 2026, on November 14, 2026. Chase Bright Steel Limited reported a net profit of 334.07 lakhs for the quarter ending September 30, 2026. The company has a registered office at Office D/115, S.MKT., Plot-514 Steel Chamber, Kalamboli Node, Raigarh, Panvel, Maharashtra.

attchmntText: Rishabh Instruments Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Rishabh Instruments Limited filed a result update presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue for H1FY27 was 4,111 Mn, up 6.3% year over year. Adjusted EBITDA stood at 718 Mn, with a margin of 17.5%. Profit after tax was 375 Mn. Standalone revenue for H1FY27 was 1,656 Mn, up 29.6% year over year. Adjusted EBITDA was 385 Mn. Profit after tax was 254 Mn. The Electrical and Electronic Instruments segment contributed approximately 79% of consolidated revenue. The High Pressure Die Casting segment contributed approximately 21%. The company stated it is prioritizing sustainable profitability in the HPDC segment.

attchmntText: Rishabh Instruments Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Rectification Of Inadvertent Error In The Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results Submitted As Part Of The Outcome Of The Board Meeting Held On November 13, 2026'.
voiceSummary: Rishabh Instruments Limited filed a rectification notice on November 13, 2026, regarding inadvertent errors in the Consolidated Statement of Profit and Loss for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The revisions affect only Earnings Per Share figures. Consolidated Q2 Basic EPS is revised from 4.69 to 4.66. Consolidated Q2 Diluted EPS is revised from 4.65 to 4.62. Consolidated H1 Basic EPS is revised from 12.82 to 9.59. Consolidated H1 Diluted EPS is revised from 12.70 to 9.50. Standalone Q2 Diluted EPS is reported as 3.47, whereas it was not previously reported. No other financial figures have changed. The revised results are available on the company website.

attchmntText: Rishabh Instruments Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Rishabh Instruments Limited filed a statement on deviation in utilization of funds raised via public issue on 11-09-2023 for Rs. 750.00 million. The deviation is pursuant to a change in objects approved by shareholders on 13-09-2024. For the quarter ended 30.09.2026, funds originally allocated Rs. 621.80 million for Expansion of Nashik Manufacturing Facility I were modified to Rs. 321.80 million, with Rs. 305.89 million utilized. Rs. 300.00 million allocated for Expansion of Nashik Manufacturing Facility II saw Rs. 296.41 million utilized, resulting in a deviation of Rs. 29.01 million. Rs. 79.20 million for General Corporate Purpose was modified to nil, with Rs. 77.21 million utilized. Audit committee and auditor comments are nil.

attchmntText: Rishabh Instruments Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Rishabh Instruments Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was 880.12 million INR for the quarter and 1,656.11 million INR for the half year. Standalone profit before tax stood at 179.73 million INR for the quarter and 340.22 million INR for the half year. Standalone profit for the period was 135.36 million INR for the quarter and 254.01 million INR for the half year. Basic earnings per share were 3.50 INR for the quarter and 6.57 INR for the half year. The statutory auditors, MSKA & Associates LLP, issued an unmodified review conclusion. The Board also noted the payment of a final dividend of Rs. 2.00 per equity share, approved by shareholders on July 31, 2026.
